attributes.name: Candle of Spirit Protection
attributes.powers:
Banish this card to evade a non-villain monster you encounter that has the Elemental, Outsider, or Undead trait, then draw a random blessing from your discard pile.

After playing this card, you may succeed at a Perception 8 check to recharge this card instead of banishing it.
